answer: A stranger who gains nothing from the answer can confirm the proof in a single sitting. Minutes are the toll no farm can dodge: 10 per proof, 1500 for 150, owed every epoch with no exception. Every whisper has a toy shop behind it, every haven a ledger, every ember a year — and the farm has stood in none of those places. Printers and agents look alike until Glove cutter goatskin mark buttoned onto the glove press calls for each goatskin is a cutting record witnessed by the master glover; after that, only agents reply.
